authorization: Standing user-authorized implementation/correctness continuation; only fixed software suites and necessary declared synthetic F5 native fixtures after publication/readiness/ownership. This does not admit a curve experiment or comparative measurements.
decision_changing_question: Does a source-faithful additive implementation preserve the reviewed cold certificate/cap implication and compose correctly with existing prefix proof/model coverage checks?
positive_next_decision: After actual independent software check, design a separately frozen paired residual/whole-search cost comparison across all four existing encodings. No unchanged scaling or present launch permission.
negative_next_decision: Retain exact smallest failing fixed input/trace and source mismatch; repair only within bounded unfrozen producer allowance or stop for additive correction after snapshot. Do not negate the reviewed lemma from an implementation defect.
inconclusive_next_decision: Retain timeout/import/native-ABI/test failures, missing assertions or censored software fixture; no pass/performance/scientific conclusion and no scope shrink.

api.refute_active: refute_active(ring, generators, degree_cap, row_cap=4096, *, diagnostics=None) -> exactly the old result mapping keys/semantics. diagnostics is an optional output dict outside that mapping.
api.checked_dispatch: checked_refute(mode, ring, generators, degree_cap, row_cap=4096, *, diagnostics=None); mode baseline uses unchanged frozen core.refute after common validation; active_support uses refute_active. All other modes rejected.
api.integration: engine_bridge.solve(ring, polys, domain, projected_bits, limits, strategy, prefix_depths, checkpoint=None, *, refuter_mode); engine_bridge.run_cell(cell, encoding, strategy, limits, checkpoint=None, *, refuter_mode). The latter is callable but forbidden in these software suites; no curve input runs.
api.compatibility: No original return-schema change. Support/input-validation diagnostics live under a distinct bridge sidecar, preserving original status/models/learned and cost maps consumed by existing checkers. Supply sidecar on each durable checkpoint and final result without replacing old fields.

source_faithfulness: Preserve every old file byte-for-byte. Prime p and frozen BoolRing/CountedRing semantics are mathematical premises; no validation of general primality is claimed.

All common input validation precedes either dispatch: integer p>=2,n>=0, degree/row caps>=0 (no bool/float), finite ordered list/tuple of polynomial mappings, integer coefficients (no bool/float), canonical integer masks0<=mask<2^n. Internal polynomial inputs accept no strings or alias keys; JSON fixture conversion is test/serialization boundary work. Reject malformed late items even if an early constant would refute.

Candidate computes A from all cleaned original generators, including above-cap/unreached generators, retains increasing original indices and passes the original generators unchanged to the selected-row kernel. No label compaction, warm starts, row cache, parent reuse or different pivot/order policy.

Factor the candidate copied kernel so a source/AST comparison can prove its body equals bound core.refute except the function signature and for-i iteration range(ring.n)->active_indices. Setup/validation/diagnostics are outside that kernel. Preserve original insert, try/overflow, cleaning, FIFO, certificate and return body exactly.

The frozen PrefixPropagator has no per-instance refuter argument and _try_prefix closes over module-global legacy.refute. Use one freshly loaded private engine module per bridge solve and a shallow private legacy namespace that overrides only refute with the bound mode dispatcher. This avoids copying callback logic and avoids mutation of the shared encoding module. Both modes use the same bridge/load/validation mechanism. No shared-global monkeypatch, sys.modules replacement or persistent refuter binding.

Assert private bridge setup does not change frozen module attributes/function identities. Original callback/backend/options/cache/fallback/clauses/model-blocking and counters_check remain used; complete callbacks must not be relabeled partial. No live mode switch within a solve.

For every valid fixed input, checked_dispatch baseline result must equal a direct call to the raw frozen core.refute, including every original result field. Compare candidate kernel directly against raw frozen core AST, not against a rewritten intermediate baseline.

counting.classification: Descriptive software/event instrumentation only, not a field-operation or machine-work total and not performance data.
counting.definitions: Support counters count the actual eager support pass over every generator; coefficient_mod_reductions includes one modulo operation per stored input coefficient, including zeros and negatives. set_bit_visits counts each set bit visited in each surviving term, not unique variables. Early baseline termination does not erase candidate setup. All-active has identical kernel but added setup. Generic allocation/loop/native/Python cost remains uncounted.
counting.separation: Common validation, active support setup, old restriction/PC/native/identity/coverage and reconstruction phases stay distinct. Do not sum incompatible units. No hidden setup reuse across calls; each residual is a fresh cold input.
counting.output_integrity: Record all support indices and counters per PC call in sidecar with mode/call index. Baseline support_setup is explicitly not performed, not a fabricated measurement; common validation still charged. Censored/native failures retain sidecar and historical status.

checkers.identity: Reuse frozen encoding.certificate_check and independent core.check_refutation for every new refuted cold result; reviewer additionally reconstructs fixed identities independently.
checkers.coverage: Reuse accepted adapter.verify_transcript and prefix_cover.verify_cover on native transcripts. Model witness checked before projection block; certified prefix cylinders + verified model projections imply projected-only completeness.
checkers.domain: Only full cube or exact existing auxiliary upper-range CNF. No arbitrary trail/clause or compact comparator extension.
checkers.censoring: Preserve complete/censored; UNKNOWN is not non-refutability and does not require candidate equality. No fallback-free or no-solver-trust claim beyond checked transcript scope.
checkers.tiny_oracle: Only fixed cold cases n<=4 and native families n<=3 may use independent Boolean enumeration in tests; no operational oracle or parameter sweep.

execution.corrections: Producer: at most3 finite unfrozen source corrections after the initial attempt, keeping fixtures/expected assertions fixed and retaining every attempt and full source bytes/hash/output. Reviewer: may correct only its own harness within4attempts; any frozen target defect stops for additive handling. No automatic retry or fixture replacement.
execution.receipts: Each attempt retains argv/cwd/environment, UTC start/end, returncode/timeout, full stdout/stderr, named assertion results, before/after frozen/new source hashes and source text for every attempted new revision, solver instance count and per-slot transcript/check result. Preserve partial records on failure; prior attempt entries append only.
execution.software_scope: Zero scientific runs, curve input invocations, benchmarks, target sweeps or historic PNEXT/PSEARCH replays. Timestamp/unittest elapsed text is custody only. Synthetic SAT calls are explicitly authorized software fixtures, not scientific samples.

future_scope.costs: All setup/restriction/search/proof/online-offline checking/native/reconstruction/failure/memory/I/O costs and complete signed/projected outputs in a separately frozen paired residual/whole-search experiment. No claimed complete counter total from this instrumentation.
future_scope.shared_charts: Separate next lane remains open; no degree inference from idempotent syntax.
future_scope.prior_degree: DEC-20261029-0857a9 accepted grouped raw-degree reduction retains its larger variable count and no runtime implication.

promotion: No H/EXP/EV/KN/goal transition, performance finding, new theorem review or experiment launch. Actual independent software outputs and native gate precede later scoped ledger synthesis.
